notes.title: Vote for Networm in Indie of the Year awards
notes.content:
I hope everyone who has downloaded Networm has enjoyed playing it. I'm currently working on a small Xmas update to it to address some small bugs and some bits and pieces of user feedback (seperate volume sliders for SFX and Music, for example) which I'll be releasing in a week or two.

In the meantime, if you have enjoyed this game, it would be fantastic if you could vote for it at this link. It should just be one click to do it, and every vote is a big help to me for the future.

http://www.indiedb.com/games/networm
